U.S. Department of Justice 

Office of the Solicitor General 

Washington, D.C. 20530 

February 19, 2019 

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re:  Department of Commerce, et. al. v. New York, et al., No. 18-966 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

The  petition  for  a  writ  of  certiorari  before  judgment  in  the  above-captioned  case  was 
granted on February 15, 2019.  The case will be set for argument in the second week of the April 
session.  Respondents and the government have agreed to the following briefing schedule:   

Petitioners’ opening brief:  March 6, 2019  
Respondents’ briefs: 
Petitioners’ reply brief: 

April 1, 2019  
One week before oral argument pursuant to Rule 25.3  

Also, the government intends to file a motion under Rule 26.8 of the Rules of this Court to 
dispense with the printing of the joint appendix and to hear the case on the original record.  The 
parties’ designations for the appendix in the court of appeals numbered approximately six thousand 
pages.  It is not feasible to prepare and print in 6⅛- by 9¼-inch booklet format those materials (or 
even a substantial subset of those materials) in this highly expedited timeframe.  The government 
will propose that the parties provide the Court with an appendix in 8½- by 11-inch format to be 
filed with petitioners’ opening brief.  Counsel for respondents has informed the government that 
respondents agree to this proposal and do not oppose the motion.   

Sincerely, 

Noel J. Francisco 
Solicitor General
